_todo: OQ-PROPS-BREAK: every number, look and loot roll here is a first guess for Shibi (M2 L1b). Behaviour and looks only: placement and box sizes live in the map's cover file (data/maps/alesia_1km_cover.json "breakables", written by tools/gen_alesia.gd from the generator block "props"), because the saved navigation hashes that file. This file is never a navigation input.
_note: breakables.<type>: health (gun damage is the WeaponDef damage per ray), melee_damage (what one blade swing does; at or above health = one swing breaks it), palette (the impact sound and the tint, data/art_materials.json tints), look (LowpolyKit.build_cover: kind, sized by the cover file's entry, or parts), loot (count_min..count_max items, 0 allowed, from the match's loot table; item_kinds empty = every kind). break_fx: the one-shot debris (CPUParticles3D, skipped headless).

chest._todo: OQ-PROPS-CHEST: every number, look and the loot roll are first guesses for Shibi (M2 L1b). Placement and the box size live in the map's cover file ("chests", tools/gen_alesia.gd from the generator block props.chests, which also keeps front_clear_m of free ground in front of each chest for the spill).
chest._note: interact_range_m: flat distance from the chest's centre within which Interact (or a bot) opens it; height_limit_m: the most the opener's feet may lie above or below the chest's bottom (LootField.nearest's 2 m). palette: the impact sound and tint. look_closed / look_open: LowpolyKit parts authored for look_size (scaled to the cover file's box). spill: the loot lands on a ring of spill_radius_m around a point spill_offset_m in front of the chest's front face (the side it opens towards, local -z turned by its yaw), at its ground height. loot: count_min..count_max items from the match's loot table (item_kinds empty = every kind).

door._todo: OQ-PROPS-DOOR: every number and look here is a first guess for Shibi (M2 L1c). Placement, the box size (opening width x height x leaf thickness), the hinge side, the swing side and the seeded start state live in the map's cover file ("doors", tools/gen_alesia.gd from the generator block doors), because the saved navigation hashes that file. This file is never a navigation input.
door._note: The keys here are the barracks door's; "gate" holds only what a wall gate does differently (WorldProps.door_cfg merges it over the rest). Both kinds slide (pocket doors: each leaf slides its own width into the wall beside the opening). interact_range_m: flat distance from the closed leaves' footprint within which Interact toggles it; height_limit_m: the most the pawn's feet may lie above or below the threshold. move_time_s: the slide from closed to open (or back). blocked_retry_s: a pawn in the doorway when the door should move (or, after a close, before its collider switches on): the door does not move and asks again after this long. bot_open_delay_s: M2 L1c commit 4 (bots opening doors); bot_open_delay_s + move_time_s must stay under data/bots.json stuck_window_s. palette: the tint (data/art_materials.json tints; an unlisted one draws the parts' own colours) and the impact sound (data/audio.json impacts.by_palette; an unlisted one is by_palette.default, wood). look: LowpolyKit parts of ONE leaf authored for look_size (+x = the side that enters the pocket), scaled to each leaf; grey-box, the art slice dresses it.
